definitions.full: H635. Ester אֶסְתֵּר proper name, feminine Esther (Persian stâra , star) — daughter of Abihail, cousin and adopted daughter of Mordecai, of tribe of Benjamin; made queen in Vashti's place by Ahasuerus; her Jewish name הֲדַסָּת q. v. Est 2:7-8 , 10 , 11 , 15 (twice in verse); 2:16-17 , 47t. Esther.
